item.title: Willow quantum chip demonstrates verifiable quantum advantage on hardware
item.description:
📝 Our Quantum Echoes algorithm is a big step toward real-world applications for quantum computing Oct 22, 2025 · Share Twitter Facebook LinkedIn Mail Copy link Our Willow quantum chip demonstrates the first-ever algorithm to achieve verifiable quantum advantage on hardware. The Quantum Echoes algorithm, a verifiable quantum advantageThis is the first time in history that any quantum computer has successfully run a verifiable algorithm that surpasses the ability of supercomputers. This implementation of the Quantum Echoes algorithm is enabled by the advances in quantum hardware of our Willow chip.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.google/technology/research/quantum-echoes-willow-verifiable-quantum-advantage/

item.title: Bild AI (YC W25) Is Hiring a Founding AI Engineer
item.description:
📝 Puneet and I (Roop) founded Bild AI to tackle the mess that is blueprint reading, cost estimation, and permit applications in construction. It's a tough technical problem that requires the newest CV and AI approaches, and we’re impact-driven to make it more efficient to build more houses, hospitals, and schools. We're building blueprint understanding with a model-garden approach, so there is a lots of ground to break.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/bild-ai/jobs/m2ilR5L-founding-engineer-applied-ai

item.title: The Logarithmic Time Perception Hypothesis
item.description:
📝 Logtime: Logarithmic Time Perception With Aging Logtime: The Subjective Scale of Life The Logarithmic Time Perception Hypothesis By James Main Kenney Time scarcer. Years getting shorter. A simple mathematical analysis shows that our time perception should be logarithmic, giving us a subjective scale of life very different from that of the calendar.
🔗 Read more: http://www.kafalas.com/Logtime.html
